# Tatiana's European Spa

> Tatiana's European Spa is a private boutique spa in Franklin, Tennessee, offering facials, massage and waxing.

- Phone: (435) 263-6868
- Email: tatianalaykam@gmail.com
- Based in: Franklin, TN
- Serves: Franklin, TN
- Hours: Mon to Fri 9 am to 6 pm; Sat 9 am to 3 pm
- Website: https://www.example.com/
- Free quote: https://www.example.com/quote/

## Services

- [Facials](https://www.example.com/services/facials/): A skin care treatment that cleanses, exfoliates and moisturizes the face.
- [Sacred Stone Massage Therapy](https://www.example.com/services/sacred-stone-massage-therapy/): A massage that uses smooth, warmed stones along with the hands.
- [Brazilian Wax](https://www.example.com/services/brazilian-wax/): A hair removal method that uses warm wax to lift hair from the root.
